verdict_text:
YES

The `keep_index` construction reproduces the required index sets exactly: for `c_attn` (3 segments of 768, block 64) it emits heads 0–4 and 6–11 within each segment, i.e. `0..319, 384..767, 768..1087, 1152..1535, 1536..1855, 1920..2303` in order, giving 2112 along dim 1 for the weight and dim 0 for the bias; for `c_proj.weight` (1 segment) it emits `0..319, 384..767` along dim 0, giving 704 rows. All other tensors are untouched, names are preserved, the four required checks run before writing, and the single output file goes to `out/T2/model.safetensors` (default path). `index_select` preserves dtype and values bit-exactly.
